title: Ing Pabayat ning Pibandian
intro: Makatalakad ka king arap ning metung a kwentu ning maragul a kapalaran, metung a bie a mipalamutian king gintu at upaya, dapot king tauli metung yang aral a mag-ingat para karing sablang manintun king yatu a kadakilaan. Malyari meng abalu ing pangatau na niting tau na ing istorya na mag-echo ya keng panaun, metung a testamento keng panandaman a kalikasan da reng pibandian ning yatu?
clues: Ibat ku king balen ning metung a dakilang Propeta, dapot pinili ke ing dalan ning kayabangan at pangalupig.
Dininan naku ning Allah maragul a pibandian, inya sa’t ding susi da ring kanakung pibandian metung lang mabayat a pabayat para king metung a masikan a grupu da ring tau.
Ding tau ku sinabi da kaku na eku magsaya keng pibandian ku, pepaganaka da kaku na ing Allah e na kaluguran ing magsaya.
Mayabang kung sinabi na ing maragul kung pibandyan ibat ya keng sarili kung beluan ampo upaya, ali keng bendisyun ibat kang Allah.
Mebabala ku laban keng korapsyon ampo mepaganaka kung panintunan ing Aldo gamit ing binie na kaku ning Allah, pero eku bisang makiramdam at tinuru ku keng kanakung pamagmaragul.
king bandang tauli, ing Allah gewa na ing yatu na lamunan na ku ampo ing tuknangan ku, at ala kung asaup laban keng kayang kautusan.
verse: So We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no body of supporters to aid him other than Allah, nor was he of those who could defend themselves. (Al-Qasas 28:81)
arabic: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِ وَبِدَارِهِ الْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُ مِن فِئَةٍ يَنصُرُونَهُ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُنتَصِرِينَ
